convention: Vacated = players listed Out or Doubtful (the engine's own convention in scripts/strategy_lab.py::rollup). At risk = players listed Questionable; they are NOT counted as absent. Both sums use only official season per-game figures the repository has captured (top 31 by minutes per game), so every total is a FLOOR.
unknown_policy: A player with no captured official minutes figure is counted in players_without_official_minutes and contributes 0, never an estimate. A team that had not filed produces None, never 0.
replacement_not_quantified: Who absorbs the vacated minutes, and what share of the vacated production the replacement returns, is NOT modelled. It needs per-player game logs and on/off splits, which this repository does not have. Publishing a replacement rate would be a guess, so the cell is left blank.

rows.minutes_note: Sum of the official season minutes-per-game of the players listed Out or Doubtful (the engine's convention). It is a FLOOR: 4 listed player(s) are outside the captured official minutes table, so their minutes are unknown and are not counted.
rows.rotation_note: Who absorbs those minutes, and how much of the vacated production they replace, is NOT quantified. Answering it needs per-player game logs and on/off splits, which this repository does not have. The vacuum is published; the replacement is deliberately left blank.
